title: The Rainbow Fish
author: Marcus Pfister
intro: The Rainbow Fish has shiny scales of many colours. They make him look very different from the other fish.
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: What is special about the Rainbow Fish?
questions.yes: The Rainbow Fish has shiny scales of many colours.

questions.q: What colour are his very shiny special scales?
questions.clue: It is the colour of a shiny spoon.
questions.yes: His special shiny scales are silver.

questions.q: Who asks the Rainbow Fish for one of his scales?
questions.clue: It is a small fish, not a shark.
questions.yes: A little blue fish asked for one of his scales.

questions.q: How does the Rainbow Fish answer him?
questions.clue: He wants to keep all his scales.
questions.yes: The Rainbow Fish rudely said no.

questions.q: Why do the other fish stop playing with him?

options.text: He was unkind to the blue fish

questions.clue: The little blue fish told them what happened.
questions.yes: The others heard how unkind he had been to the blue fish.

questions.q: Who tells the Rainbow Fish to visit the octopus?
questions.clue: It is his only friend left.
questions.yes: The starfish told him to visit the wise octopus.

questions.q: Where does the wise octopus live?
questions.clue: It is a hollow place in the rocks.
questions.yes: The wise octopus lives in a cave.

questions.q: Who told the octopus about the Rainbow Fish?
questions.clue: They move across the top of the sea.
questions.yes: The octopus said the waves told her his story.

questions.q: What does the octopus tell him to do?
questions.clue: He should give some away to the other fish.
questions.yes: The octopus told him to share his scales.

questions.q: What does the octopus say he will learn?
questions.clue: Sharing will help him feel this way.
questions.yes: The octopus said he would learn how to be happy.
The octopus vanished in a cloud of ink.

questions.q: Who does the Rainbow Fish give his first scale to?
questions.clue: It is the fish who asked at the start.
questions.yes: He gave his first scale to the little blue fish.

questions.q: How does the Rainbow Fish feel after giving the scale away?
questions.clue: He sees how happy the little fish is.
questions.yes: The Rainbow Fish felt much better.

questions.q: What happens when the other fish ask for scales?

options.text: He gives one to each fish
He swims far away to hide

questions.clue: He shares, just like the octopus said.
questions.yes: He gave a shiny scale to each fish.

questions.q: How many shiny scales does he keep for himself?
questions.clue: He gave nearly all of them away.
questions.yes: The Rainbow Fish kept only one shiny scale, and he was happy.
